text:
maria (PM): Quick sync: proposal for 'reserved headroom' as a packaged feature for committed customers. Goal: keep tail latency stable during short spikes without forcing big reserved idle clusters. Need launch criteria and a minimal ops playbook.

jon (Eng): Overall +1. Two quick questions: 1) How strict is the guarantee (ms limits)? 2) Do we expose a metric so customers can see buffer burn?

maria (PM): Proposal: p95 < 150ms, p99 < 300ms under normal commit + during buffer consumption. We must expose tenant-visible buffer_remaining and buffer_used metrics.

reena (Infra): Implementation constraints: full idle nodes are costly. Better approach: keep small warm lanes + a token-bucket tracking service that hands out slots. We'll call it HeadroomService.

lee (SRE): Operational requirements: auto-fallback must be deterministic. If headroom exhausted, route to either cheaper quantized variant or spill to secondary region. We need a canary and rollback triggers.

sam (Finance): Pricing: two viable models: include small headroom in the reservation fee (flat uplift) or bill consumption of headroom as metered minutes. Prefer flat uplift for predictable revenue. I'll model both.

anya (Legal): Customers will want SLA language on headroom. We'll need to define 'buffer exhaustion' and acceptable failover behavior, plus credit caps and opt-in for cross-region spill. Also check privacy/residency clauses for private deployments.

jon (Eng): Design notes:
- HeadroomService maintains token buckets per reservation id.
- Routing policy: reserved -> headroom -> fallbackVariant.
- Keep a tiny pinned KV cache for each tenant while in headroom to avoid warmup penalty.

lee (SRE): Runbook sketch:
- Chaos exercise: force token exhaustion and validate fallback paths.
- Canary: route 1% of traffic from 2 pilot customers for 72h.
- Escalation: if p99 > 500ms for 5m or error rate increases by 1% sustained 5m, auto-roll to fallback and page oncall.

maria (PM): Acceptance criteria draft:
- Metrics: per-tenant headroom_usage, headroom_remaining, failover_count, average failover_latency.
- Safety: rollback if error spike >=1% for 5m or >=300 failed requests in 10m.
- Billing: headroom included in tier by default with opt-out to metered billing.
- Legal: opt-in required for cross-region spill.

reena (Infra): Engineering tasks:
- Build HeadroomService + token bookkeeping.
- Integrate with smart-routing layer.
- KV pinning interface + soft-eviction grace.
- Emit per-tenant metrics to metrics pipeline.

jon (Eng): config sketch for ops:
```
headroom:
  mode: percent # or token
  percent: 8
  token_minutes: 20
  fallback: quantized_model | spill_region
  billing: included | metered
  triggers:
    latency_p99_threshold_ms: 500
    error_rate_delta_pct: 1
```

sam (Finance): initial price suggestion: add 10% uplift to reservation at tier-1; metered path: $Y per minute of headroom consumed. I'll post a detailed spreadsheet.

anya (Legal): I'll prepare SLA language and a cross-region consent checkbox for contracts. Also will draft incident credit calculation for headroom failures.

lee (SRE): Monitoring thresholds to add: sustained headroom use >70% for 30m -> notify capacity; >95% -> auto-recommend customer contact. Also add an alert for headroom_throttle_events.

maria (PM): Timeline proposal:
- Week 0-1: finalize design + pricing model
- Week 2-4: engineering sprint (HeadroomService + routing + metrics)
- Week 5: internal canary + chaos testing
- Week 6-7: pilot with up to 3 customers
- Week 8: GA if pilot metrics OK

reena (Infra): dependency: need new metric ingestion ticket for per-tenant headroom metrics. I'll file to eng-infra.

devex-bot: Ticket INFRA-4922 created: "ingest per-tenant headroom metrics" assigned to eng-infra.

lee (SRE): Limit pilot to 3 customers to reduce blast radius. Agree on contract changes for pilot.

sam (Finance): Agree on pilot cap and contract addendum.

maria (PM): Next steps: jon + reena produce spec doc by EOD Tue; sam posts pricing model; anya drafts SLA clauses; lee posts canary plan. Scheduling 30m sync Thu AM.

jon (Eng): Ack, will put spec into product-docs and link here.

reena (Infra): Ack, will prototype soft-eviction and KV pin.

lee (SRE): Will prepare canary checklist and chaos scenarios.

maria (PM): Thanks all :thumbsup: keeping this thread as primary decision record.
